messages:
maria: heads up — running into a weird parity issue between node/python SDKs on the embeddings+rerank sample app. batching helper pads to batch size but responses come back with inconsistent vector lengths. repro in prod-sim (small sample).

maria: minimal repro: send 3 inputs, helper pads to 4, request body looks fine, response returns 3 embeddings plus one short vector (len 1535) while model profile says 1536.

maria: example request snippet (node):
```js
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-embed-1536',
  input: ['a','b','c'] // internally padded to 4 for batch
});
```

maria: response (truncated):
```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.01, 0.002, ..., 0.123]},
    {"embedding": [0.02, ...]},
    {"embedding": [0.03, ...]},
    {"embedding": [0.01, 0.002, ..., /* only 1535 floats here */ ]}
  ]
}
```

tony: ah yeah i saw something similar yesterday when the batcher did a pad-with-null trick. quick Q: are you using the batching helper that returns a flattened buffer or the sdk's internal batcher?

maria: using devex batch helper (sample-app v0.3.1). it returns an array of inputs where we tag padded rows with _pad=true. the server should drop padded rows before computing embeddings. seems like a codepath where it's encoding a padded vector but not filling the last float.

jack: can you share exact node lib version? we fixed an off-by-one in the quantized path a while back but maybe it didn't land to sample app.

maria: node sdk 0.8.2, python sdk (in a different test) 0.8.2 too. python sample app doesn't hit the bug — it strips pads earlier.

sophia: could also be related to auth refresh + retry behavior. if token refresh triggers a retry that recombines batched items, ordering might be off and padding flags could get mismatched. saw similar in auth-retry issue last quarter.

maria: good call — logs show a 401 during initial call, client retried once after refresh. the devex batch helper logs:
```
[devex-batcher] building batch: size=4 padded=1 pad_index=3
[auth] token expired, refresh->retry
[devex-batcher] replaying batch after retry
```

maria: after replay, the batch metadata (pad_index) looks fine, but response assembly step assumes all embeddings are full length and doesn't sanity-check length before concatenation.

tony: workaround: validate each embedding length before using. if length != profile.dim then throw and surface to user. i'll add a small check in helper.

jack: for a proper fix we should: (1) ensure retry preserves pad metadata, (2) server returns explicit embedding_dim in response header/body, and (3) SDK validates embedding length and fails fast.

maria: agreed. also the rerank endpoint expects arrays of scores tied to embeddings by index; if ordering flips, rerank returns wrong results — very subtle.

sophia: can we add an integration test that simulates auth expiry mid-batch and asserts pad flags preserved? i'll add to CI matrix (node+python).

devex-bot: created issue DE-4821: "batcher pad mismatch on auth-retry -> short embedding" and linked PR template.

tony: i'll draft a patch: node helper v0.3.2 will add length checks + preserve pad metadata in the retry queue. target: ship canary tomorrow.

maria: thanks — assigned to @tony. i'll update sample app and add repro steps in the issue. hoping to keep it low-risk (just validation + metadata preservation). :thumbsup:

jack: also request to server team: include "embedding_dim" in /v1/embeddings response top-level metadata so SDKs don't have to assume. cc @eng-runtime.

maria: noted. shipping that will help SDK parity checks across languages.

sophia: adding test plan: node/python matrix x auth-expiry x batch-sizes (1..8) x padding pos (start/mid/end). will report pass/fail in DE-4821.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone.

tony: will post canary link when ready.

maria: closing loop here once CI green.
